WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT sf.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(sf.anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = sf.transref
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = sf.trdref2
  GROUP BY sf.transref, t.tradekind
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s.transref, s.tradekind, s.avg_anlycount,
         s.avg_anlycount - b.overall_avg AS difference
  FROM step1 AS s
  CROSS JOIN step2 AS b
  WHERE s.avg_anlycount > b.overall_avg
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_anlycount) AS avg_coverage,
         AVG(difference) AS avg_difference
  FROM step3
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_coverage) AS overall_avg_coverage
  FROM step4
)
SELECT s.tradekind, s.avg_coverage, s.avg_difference,
       s.avg_coverage / b.overall_avg_coverage AS ratio
FROM step4 AS s
CROSS JOIN step5 AS b
